messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx rate on prod-gateway (service=gateway, region=us-east-1). 5m error rate spike, primary symptom: timeouts + 502s. Auto-page to #oncall.

sara-ng: seeing it, joining. any customer reports yet?

devon-p: getting a noisy set of 429s from quota-proxy in the gateway logs, followed by backend 502s. looks like quota rejection -> upstream backlog -> timeouts.

mike-k: confirm. tail of gateway logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z gateway [info] req id=abc123 status=429 reason=quota_exceeded route=/v1/generate tenant=tn-543
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z gateway [warn] req id=abc124 upstream_timeout service=model-serv-1
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z gateway [error] req id=abc125 status=502 upstream=unavailable
```

jia-ml: the pattern is classic cascading: quota-proxy returns 429s which clients retry, increasing concurrency, then model backend tails hit queues and 5xx. any recent quota changes?

leo-sre: I see a config push 13:55 UTC to quota-proxy that tightened per-tenant burst window. Change: `quota-window-ms: 60000 -> 30000` and reduced `burst_tokens` by 50%.

sara-ng: who rolled that? devon-p - that was your change earlier today right?

devon-p: yeah that was a follow-up from testing, intended to prevent long-tail noisy tenants consuming bursts. didn't expect it to interact with gateway retries. :grimacing:

mike-k: customers are starting to see failures on long-running streaming calls. We need immediate mitigations: 1) stop aggressive retries at gateway, 2) relax quota limits, 3) route high-latency requests to fallback pool.

jia-ml: suggest short-term: patch quota-proxy to restore previous burst_tokens and window. also add a temporary rate-shunt that responds with a 429-suggested-retry-after header to reduce hot retries.

leo-sre: agreed. I'm going to patch now. Pushing a rollback to quota-proxy config in k8s.

leo-sre: run commands:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap quota-proxy-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"burst_tokens":"200","quota_window_ms":"60000"}}'
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/quota-proxy
```

sara-ng: also reduce client-side retries at gateway for now. mike-k can you deploy the quick retry-polic y change?

mike-k: on it. patching gateway config to reduce retries and enable jitter:
```
retries:
  max_attempts: 1
  retry_on: gateway-error,connect-failure
  backoff:
    base_ms: 200
    max_ms: 2000
```

mike-k: restarting gateway rolling update (3 pods at a time) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon-p: i'm watching model-serv queue length. currently at 78% of capacity but falling as retries back off.

incident-bot: Update: quota-proxy rollout succeeded on 6/6 pods (completed). gateway rolling update at 2/6.

sara-ng: status check — any customers with sustained errors? Support slack says 2 upticket customers reporting degraded latency; no major revenue-impacting tenants yet.

jia-ml: telemetry: 429s dropped 65% after quota rollback; 5xx error rate decreased from peak 11% to 2.7% in 6 minutes. latency p95 improving.

leo-sre: leaving a sticky fallback rule to route requests with seq_length>2048 to dedicated pool 'dedicated-lowlatency' for the next 30m.

mike-k: applied routing override via feature-flag 'route_large_seq_to_dedicated'.

sara-ng: good. next steps: (A) Monitor 30m window. (B) Postmortem: root cause is quota config change + client retry behaviour + lack of circuit-breaker on model-serv. (C) Customer comms draft.

devon-p: will open a rollback PR and add a canary for quota tuning. Also adding a sanity check to alert if 429->5xx ratio > 0.3.

jia-ml: recommend a longer-term fix: implement server-side retry budget and a queue length circuit-breaker on model-serv. I'll write a proposal.

leo-sre: paging: @mike-k you'll stay for the next 30 min to watch gateway roll, @devon-p monitor quota-proxy logs, @jia-ml monitor model serv health. I'm on call until 15:30 UTC if anything flares.

mike-k: staying. :thumbsup:

devon-p: logs look stable, no new surge. closing initial mitigation ticket and creating INCIDENT-2026-033 for postmortem.

sara-ng: support notify: please send a short prod incident update to affected tenants: brief description + mitigation + ETA for full postmortem. draft:
"We experienced elevated errors and timeouts on the API between 13:55–14:15 UTC due to a quota configuration change that caused cascading retries. We rolled back the change, applied routing mitigations, and error rates have returned to normal. Full postmortem forthcoming."

mike-k: sent to support queue.

incident-bot: Incident severity reduced to SEV-3. Monitoring for 30 more minutes. :white_check_mark:

sara-ng: Great job team — keep watching and we'll do a follow-up doc.
